beats.subline: Tuesday, November 10, 2026 close — stocks slipped as a hotter-than-expected October CPI reading revived Fed rate-hike fears and Nvidia extended its slide.
beats.body: October CPI came in hotter than expected, pushing the 10-year Treasury yield back near 5% and raising the odds of a December Fed rate hike; Nvidia fell more than 5% as its board's investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's reported ties to a suspected Chinese intelligence operative continued to weigh on chip stocks.

beats.headline: No fresh news on this beat right now
beats.body: An extensive search turned up nothing distinct within the 72-hour window beyond the Iran-Hormuz standoff and the UK base security move already covered elsewhere in this brief, and no other newer, substantive story was confirmed today.

beats.headline: Taiwan says China's Liaoning carrier group drilled to restrict naval access in the Western Pacific
beats.body: Taiwan's defense minister, Wellington Koo, said China's Liaoning aircraft carrier group and other PLA Navy formations recently ran area-denial training east of Taiwan aimed at restricting the movement of opposing forces, adding a maritime and air dimension to Chinese pressure beyond the Taiwan Strait; Taiwan said it is tracking the activity through joint intelligence sharing with partners.

beats.headline: US pulls tankers and Ospreys from UK base amid unspecified Iran-linked threat
beats.body: At least eight KC-135 refueling tankers and three Osprey tilt-rotors left RAF Mildenhall in England for bases in Germany, Spain and Scotland, with the Ospreys relocating to nearby RAF Lakenheath; US officials cited 'enhanced force protection measures' without detailing the threat, while reporting tied the move to a threat from Iran.

beats.headline: Army contracts AI drone software to hunt explosive threats for tank protection
beats.body: Safe Pro Group won a $2.5 million US Army prime contract to run its AI-based threat-detection software aboard Anduril's Ghost-X drone, which can identify and geolocate more than 150 types of explosive threats in real time to protect Abrams tanks; it's the company's first prime Army contract.

beats.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Whiteboards, Sheets and Meetings to challenge Microsoft and Google
beats.body: Anthropic rolled out three new Claude workplace features — Whiteboards for turning team discussions into visual plans, a beta of Sheets, and Meetings for generating action items from conversations — plus a newly generally available Claude Data tool, pushing further into productivity software as the company heads toward its Nasdaq IPO.

beats.headline: Bears' Luther Burden III in concussion protocol after Buccaneers game
beats.body: Burden was hurt late in Sunday night's win over Tampa Bay after a hit from Buccaneers rookie Rueben Bain Jr. and did not return; coach Ben Johnson confirmed the concussion, and Chicago's Week 10 bye gives its leading receiver extra time to clear the NFL's five-step protocol before a Week 11 game against the Saints.

beats.body: Sunday's NASCAR Cup Series finale at Homestead-Miami Speedway and its outcome fall within the 7-day spoiler window, and no other non-spoiler sponsorship, contract, or schedule news on Byron surfaced within the 72-hour window.

beats.headline: Fire damages academic building at PCA-affiliated Covenant College
beats.body: A vehicle fire in a parking lot beside Sanderson Hall, one of Covenant College's main academic buildings, damaged the building's exterior and left smoke damage inside on Sunday; no one was injured, and classes were canceled Monday while the building was cleaned and inspected.
